lessons.title: Make repetition predictable.

segments.text: Welcome to Daywire for October twenty-third, twenty twenty-six. First, a fictional example from our demo. Aster version one point two point four is a preview for Node jay ess. General availability hasn't been announced. It routes simple classification requests to a smaller model and uncertain ones to a larger model. The catch? A cheaper request doesn't automatically mean a cheaper system. Even a bargain likes to bring friends to the bill. That's Daywire. Thanks for listening.

draft.artwork_brief: Conceptual editorial photograph of two differently sized paper apertures on a warm desk, expressing selective routing. No labels, logos, people or documentary claims.
